title: Serve with one gathered awareness
summary: Service becomes true when love is gathered toward the One. Gather love into the Lord's Will before calling it service.
takeaway: Gather love into the Lord's Will before calling it service.
lifeApplication: Before seva, gather pleasure and pain under Hukam and let love for the Lord set the shape of the act.

source.shortMeaning: Service becomes true when love is gathered toward the One.
source.lifeApplication: Before seva, gather the mind and lower the self.
